conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Varying your tone means changing the pitch and volume of your voice, while varying your pace involves speeding up or slowing down your delivery to emphasize points. This keeps the audience engaged and highlights key information.

conversation.message: For example, you might lower your voice and slow down to emphasize a serious point, or speed up and raise your pitch slightly when sharing exciting news.
